headline: Cyber-incident recovery drives strong profit growth
summary_short: Stryker's Q2 FY2026 net sales rose 9.4% y/y to $6,589M (9.0% organic, all from unit volume), with GAAP diluted EPS of $3.30 (+44.1% y/y) and net income of $1,276M as the company continued recovering from its Q1 cyber incident; adjusted EPS was $3.69 (+17.9% y/y).
summary_long: Net sales of $6,589M grew 9.4% y/y (9.0% organic, all from unit volume) across both MedSurg/Neurotechnology (+9.7%) and Orthopaedics (+9.1%). GAAP operating margin expanded to 25.2% from 18.5% y/y, helped by a $158M one-time reversal of 2025 tariffs embedded in reported results (adjusted operating margin, which excludes it, was 27.4%, +170bp y/y). GAAP EPS of $3.30 (+44.1% y/y) and net income of $1,276M reflect recovery from Q1's cyber-incident disruption plus the tariff reversal; adjusted EPS was $3.69 (+17.9% y/y). H1 operating cash flow was $1,842M. Cash rose to $3,391M; long-term debt eased to $14,192M. Stryker narrowed FY2026 guidance to 8.3%-9.3% organic sales growth and $14.95-$15.10 adjusted EPS.
